tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List one directory level in name order, distinguishing directories.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

max_entries.description: Maximum entries; default 200. Further entries cause a truncation notice.

path.description: File or directory path; defaults to the Agent workspace (.).

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Activate one discoverable skill and its dependencies.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read an inclusive one-based line range; report I/O and range errors.

end_line.description: Last line; default 0 reads through EOF.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.

tools.name: unload_skill
tools.description: Remove one explicit skill root; retain shared dependencies and past manuals.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a file and missing parents. Refuse replacing an existing file without overwrite:true; append mode creates or appends.

append.description: Append or create; default false. When true, overwrite is irrelevant.

content.description: Exact text to write; empty text is valid.

overwrite.description: Allow replacement of existing bytes; default false.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.
